motion.name: product-hover
motion.purpose: Existing app icon lifts 6px and rotates -3 degrees on hover or focus; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary link
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; background:var(--ink); color:var(--on-accent); padding:16px 21px; border-radius:4px; font:14px Geist,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 180ms; } .ds-primary:hover { background:var(--accent); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Text link
components.css: .ds-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; font:500 14px Geist,sans-serif; color:var(--ink); text-decoration:none; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:5px; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Direct work, About and contact navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:36px; font:14px Geist,sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; color:var(--ink); text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Availability
components.css: .ds-status { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; color:var(--muted); font:12px Geist,sans-serif; } .ds-status span { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:#4b7753; }

components.name: Recommendation disclosure
components.html:
Read full recommendation

Full recommendation appears here.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { color:var(--ink); font:15px/1.8 Geist,sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure summary { cursor:pointer; padding:8px 0; font-size:13px; } .ds-disclosure summary:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview: A professional introduction supported by actual products and career history. Large serif headlines establish identity; quiet sans-serif text makes project details easy to scan. Existing photography brings the person into the portfolio.
keyCharacteristics: Forest text and pale ivory surfaces.
dos: Do preserve authentic project descriptions, URLs, and recommendation wording.
Do use existing images at appropriate sizes.
Do keep body text and action links legible across breakpoints.
donts: Don't invent impact metrics or case-study claims.
Don't add ornamental technology diagrams or competing card systems.
